trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 are done, with no separate task of its own. Work through the roadmap in this guide in order and it pops last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission: follow the on-screen prompts through the opening day and the drive back into Leonida. It unlocks during normal story progress and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The chapter ends after its final mission, and the trophy pops on the completion screen. Do the meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude before the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Keep playing the story in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes and the next one begins.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Story progress only, no side content is required for this one.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It unlocks at the end of the story, after the last mission's closing cutscene. There is no post-game requirement for this one.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears in the story mission list after the early chapters; complete its objectives and the trophy pops on the results screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Plan the approach on the planning screen first, then complete every objective inside the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Follow the mission markers and complete each objective in order.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Complete every stage of the mission; the trophy pops on the results screen.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. The takedown takes place at the airport, so complete all of its objectives to finish it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story operation, so complete every objective and survive the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion. The checklist covers story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and exploration, and the tracker on this page mirrors the in-game checklist. Finish the last remaining item and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Any stunt counts: jumps, near misses, drifts, and airtime. Use the stunt jumps scattered around Vice City and the highways, since each successful stunt adds to the total. The tracker counts your progress toward 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting, and WAiNK. One attempt at each is enough, and you do not need to win any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has a score threshold for gold, so aim steady, reload between targets, and replay any challenge that lands silver. All 42 must be gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Fly the racing line, cut corners through the rings, and use boost on the straights. Each location's win is tracked separately.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street races, off-road, and water races all count, but each race only counts once, so repeat wins on the same race do not add up. Enter new races from the map until you reach 20 wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges appear at the piers, so accept Cal's challenge, match the prompts to reel in the bigger catch, and land more weight than him before time runs out.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Visit an arcade in Vice City, pick any cabinet, and play it through to the end. A high score is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Complete Andy's mission strand in order; the final mission unlocks after the earlier ones are done.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Work through Kenton's strand until the final mission unlocks, then complete it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Complete Billy's strand in order until the final mission unlocks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question marks on the map, so talk to them, take the job, and finish each strand. Any 8 strands count toward the total.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Work through Randy's strand to its final mission and complete it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Complete Tyrone's strand in order; the final mission closes it out.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots, and do it in Chapter 1, before the story moves on. The spots are marked once you start meditating, so visit each one and complete the meditation. Missed spots cannot be revisited after Chapter 1 closes, which makes this the guide's only missable trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Bret marks the animal's territory on the map, so track it, approach downwind, and take the shot. Only the marked unique animal counts.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, in shops, bars, and landmarks. Collect every card in a set to complete it, and three full sets earn the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app at marked spots across the map and tag each one. Fast travel between districts to cover the map quickly.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying, and exploration, so check the challenges menu and clear the easy ones first. Any 50 count.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escape. Build heat with your partner nearby, break line of sight, and hide until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner and keep your wanted level the whole time. Hit the till, move straight to the next shop, and do not let the stars drop between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive or enter counts toward the total, so borrow cars on the street, at dealers, and in missions. Variety matters, not repeats.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and chain headshots while time slows. A crowded street fight is the easiest setup.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in a way that is not scheduled. Get airside at the airport and take off in a plane without a flight plan. Any runway departure that is not booked counts.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos. When the military rolls Rhinos in at high wanted levels, take one on. Sticky bombs on the rear armor work best, so plant them and survive the encounter.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Go in quiet: take out the cameras first, avoid the guard's sightline, crack the cases, and leave before the alarm trips.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big jobs, so plan the crew, crack the vault, grab the cash, and lose the heat before the escape counts.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, crack the rear doors, take the cash, and lose the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every named district on the map: Vice City, the Keys, the swamps, and the small towns. Each new area fills in on the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations are marked once you find them, so hit one per gang. Repeats for the same gang do not count.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Sit at a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car through the showroom glass, since a fast exit through the front window is the classic move.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. Finish a full game. Strikes help, but completing the game is what counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach a partnership milestone with mass appeal. Build your partnership's following through shared activities until the milestone triggers.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices. The game tracks decisions across missions and free roam, so keep playing and choosing. The count builds over the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try. Fail an activity once, then pass it on the immediate retry, and the trophy pops on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Strange events hide in the corners of Leonida, and the swamps at night and the desert roads are the best places to look.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Drive past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the car window, and connect. Timing the swing at speed is the trick.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from big robberies, so hand them to your contacts and collect the clean cash until the total reaches $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops. Clothes, weapons, car mods, and food all count, so buy across every shop type and the total adds up fast.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are listed on the property site, so purchase each one. The trophy pops on the eighth.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Photograph or scan 10 different vehicles with the app, and each new registration counts.
